scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API,AI -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @hirematch/web" "npm run dev -w @hirematch/api" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir apps/ai-service"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hirematch/types && npm run build -w @hirematch/validation && npm run build -w @hirematch/shared
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @hirematch/api && npm run build -w @hirematch/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @hirematch/api && npm run typecheck -w @hirematch/web
